mentions.name: Vibe-coded household task tracker
mentions.description: A custom task tracker built with AI assistance (vibe coding), tailored to the way the household tackles tasks; it is self-owned so it won't be paywalled in the future.
mentions.source_excerpt: She decided to give vibe coding a try. She’s an artist, not an engineer, but with a little help she was able to make a task tracker for us. She tailored it to the way we tackle our tasks and, again, it’s really nice knowing it won’t get paywalled in the future.
